blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Predictive Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA , an Action-Centric Predictive Vision–Language–Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection . Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook . It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents . Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path , enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.
blocks.zh: 预测展望-语言-行动(VLA)模型旨在通过未来的观测或世界动态预测来改进机器人操纵. 然而,现有方法往往未能实现这种潜力,而且未能很好地实施直接行动预测模型。 我们认为,这些限制来自观察与行动之间的模式不一致,以及联合优化冲突,这些冲突驱使人们远离以行动为中心的目标。 为此,我们引入了ATI-VLA, 即通过可操作对齐然后适应性注射的“行动预测愿景-语言-行动框架”。 具体来说,它遵循的是两步设计: 1) 通过共同守则,对可采取行动的代表性进行调整。 它通过统一编码本将两种模式映射成一个共享的离散潜伏空间,使预测潜伏观测易于用于行动生成和减缓模式的错配,从而将预测观测与行动表述结合起来。 2) 预测性底线的适应性行动注射 在此基础上,它通过轻量级的适应性侧路,将预测观测潜伏物注入动作解码,作为明确的预测前兆,从而能够在单一行动中心目标下进行适应性预测。 关于模拟和现实世界机器人任务的广泛实验表明,ATI-VLA以更快的聚合速度实现最先进的性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models have emerged as a unified paradigm for robotic manipulation, traditionally mapping observations and language instructions directly to low-level actions [ 18 , 59 , 27 , 4 , 32 , 51 , 52 , 29 ] , as shown in Fig. 1(a) . More recently, predictive VLA [ 25 , 73 , 69 , 67 ] approaches extend this paradigm by explicitly forecasting future observations or world dynamics to provide anticipatory guidance for action generation, as shown in Fig. 1(b) .
blocks.zh: Vision–Language–Action(VLA)模型已作为机器人操纵的统一范式出现,传统的绘图观测和语言指令直接面向低级动作[18,59,27,4,32,51,52,29],如图1(a)所示. 最近,如图1(b)所示,预测VLA[25、73、69、67]办法扩展了这一范式,明确预测未来的观测或世界动态,为行动产生提供预测性指导。

Figure 1 : Overview of VLA paradigms and motivation for ATI-VLA . Figures (a)–(c) compare general (non-predictive) VLA, predictive VLA, and our proposed action-centric predictive framework, ATI-VLA . Figures (d)–(f) identify key limitations of existing predictive VLA approaches, including observation–action modality gaps and slow convergence induced by joint optimization, which are responsible for their inferior performance relative to general VLA.
By addressing these limitations, ATI-VLA enables the predictive VLA paradigm to more fully realize its potential, achieving state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

blocks.en: However, our analysis reveals that existing predictive VLA approaches generally underperform non-predictive VLA baselines, as illustrated in Fig. 1(d) . This indicates that introducing future prediction as an auxiliary task does not reliably translate into effective improvements in action generation. We argue that this performance gap arises because these predictive approaches fail to maintain an action-centric learning focus, primarily due to two factors: i) The Modality Gap Between Visual Observation and Action. As shown in Fig. 1(e) , latent distributions analysis of recent predictive VLA models [ 67 , 45 ] reveals a pronounced modal gap between observation prediction and action generation. This gap weakens the grounding of predictive representations in action generation, thereby diluting the action-centric learning focus. ii) Optimization Conflicts Induced by Joint Training. Existing predictive VLA paradigms typically introduce future prediction as an auxiliary task by directly adding its loss to the action objective. As illustrated in Fig. 1(f) , such joint optimization leads to unstable training dynamics and slow convergence. Moreover, competing gradients from prediction and action objectives can divert optimization away from action-centric objectives and, in extreme cases, result in training collapse [ 67 ] . Together, these factors hinder predictive VLA approaches from fully realizing their performance potential. We provide a more in-depth analysis of these two issues in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的分析表明,如图1(d)所示,现有的预测性甚低水平活动方法一般表现不佳。 这表明,将未来的预测作为一项辅助任务,并不能可靠地转化为行动生成的有效改进。 我们认为,出现这种绩效差距是因为这些预测方法未能保持以行动为中心的学习重点,这主要是由于两个因素:(一)视觉观察和行动之间的模式差距。 如图1(e)所示,对近期预测VLA模型的潜在分布分析[67、45]揭示了观测预测与行动生成之间的明显模式差距。 这种差距削弱了动作生成中预测表达的基础,从而淡化了以动作为中心的学习重点. (二) 联合培训引起的冲突优化。 现有的预测VLA范式一般将未来的预测作为辅助任务,直接将其损失加到动作目标上. 如图1(f)所示,这种联合优化导致培训动态不稳定和趋同缓慢。 此外,与预测和行动目标相竞争的梯度可能使优化偏离以行动为中心的目标,并在极端情况下导致培训崩溃[67]。 这些因素加在一起,阻碍了预测的VLA方法充分实现其性能潜力。 我们在附录C.2中更深入地分析了这两个问题。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose ATI-VLA , an action-centric predictive VLA framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection , explicitly aligning predictive representations with action generation and injecting predictive information under a single action-centric objective. Specifically, as shown in Fig. 1(c) , ATI-VLA follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. To bridge the modal gap between predictive observations and action generation, ATI-VLA introduces an actionable representation alignment via a shared codebook. By mapping both modalities into a unified discrete latent space, predictive representations are directly grounded in the action space, making them readily compatible with the action decoding process rather than being implicitly entangled through joint training as in prior approaches. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon the aligned and actionable representations, ATI-VLA further introduces an action-centric adaptive injection mechanism to integrate predictive information into action generation. To enable predictive guidance to adapt as action generation progresses, we employ a lightweight adaptive side-path that modulates the action decoding process conditioned on predictive latents. Moreover, to avoid predictive information from overly interfering with action decoding, this modulation is applied at regular layer intervals, allowing predictive guidance while preserving fine-grained control.
Crucially, this injection is optimized solely with the action loss, ensuring that predictive information serves purely as guidance without inducing optimization conflicts.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提议通过可操作性对齐(Actionable Accords)和可适应性注射(Adapentive Injection)建立一个以行动为中心的VLA预测框架(ATI-VLA),明确将预测表达与行动生成相配合,并在一个以行动为中心的单一目标下注入预测信息。 具体而言,如图1(c)所示,ATI-VLA遵循两步设计: 1) 通过共同守则,实现可操作的表述对齐。 为了弥合预测观测与行动生成之间的模式差距,ATI-VLA通过共享代码集引入了可操作的表示协调. 通过将两种模式映射到一个统一的离散潜伏空间,预测性表述直接扎根于行动空间,使其与行动解码过程容易兼容,而不是像以前的做法那样通过联合培训被含蓄地缠绕在一起。 2) 预测性底片的动因适应注射。 ATI-VLA在一致和可操作的表述基础上,进一步引入了以行动为中心的适应性注入机制,将预测信息纳入行动生成。 为了使预测性指导能够随着动作生成的进展而适应,我们采用了一种轻量级的适应性侧路,以预测性潜伏为条件调节动作解码过程。 此外,为了避免预测性信息过度干扰动作解码,这种调制是按正常的层间距进行,允许预测性引导,同时保留精细的控制.
关键的是,这种注入只是随动作损失而优化,确保预测信息纯粹起到引导作用,而不会诱发优化冲突。

blocks.en:
Extensive experimental results demonstrate that, by addressing the aforementioned challenges, ATI-VLA is able to fully unlock the potential of predictive VLA paradigms.
Across both simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks, ATI-VLA consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, while exhibiting faster convergence compared to existing predictive approaches. To summarize, our main contributions are as follows: • We propose ATI-VLA , an action-centric predictive VLA framework with an Align-Then-Inject design, which effectively addresses the lack of action-centric learning in existing predictive paradigms. • We introduce an actionable representation alignment via a shared codebook to ground predictive observations directly in the action space. • We design an action-centric adaptive injection strategy that integrates predictive information into action decoding via a lightweight side-path under a single action-centric objective. • Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of ATI-VLA, achieving state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验结果表明,通过应对上述挑战,ATI-VLA能够充分释放预测性VLA范式的潜力.
无论是模拟基准还是现实世界的机器人任务,ATI-VLA都始终实现最先进的性能,同时与现有的预测方法相比,表现出更快的趋同. 概括而言,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提议ATI-VLA,这是一个以行动为中心的VLA预测框架,其设计是Align-Enter-Inject,有效地解决了在现有预测范式中缺乏以行动为中心的学习的问题。 我们通过一个共用代码簿,对可操作的表示方式进行统一,直接在行动空间进行预测观测。 我们设计了一个以行动为中心的适应性注射战略,将预测信息通过一个以行动为中心的单一目标下的轻量级侧路,整合到动作解码中. · 广泛的实验验证ATI-VLA的有效性,以更快的趋同实现最新性能.

blocks.en: Problem Definition. As discussed above, this design often introduces a modality gap between predictive and action representations, along with competing optimization objectives that weaken action-centric learning. As a result, predictive information may fail to effectively support action generation and can degrade training stability. The central problem we address is how to leverage predictive representations to enhance action generation while preserving action-centric optimization.

blocks.zh: 2.2 ATI-VLA

blocks.en: 2.2.1 OVERVIEW

In this section,
we present ATI-VLA, an Alignment Then Injection framework that
couples Actionable Representation Alignment with Action-Centric Adaptive Injection. ATI-VLA is trained in two stages (Algorithm 1 ): we first optimize Actionable Representation Alignment to learn a unified, actionable latent space via a shared codebook, making predictive observation latents directly usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment.
We then freeze the Alignment module and train Action-Centric Adaptive Injection with a lightweight adaptive side-path to inject predictive latents into action decoding, optimizing only the action objective. We next elaborate on the two steps in turn, including their architectures and training objectives.

然后,我们冻结了对齐模块,并用轻量级的适应性侧式注射法培训行动-儿童适应性注射法,将预测潜伏剂注入行动解码,仅优化行动目标。 我们接下来将逐个阐述这两个步骤,包括其结构和培训目标。

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Actionable Representation Alignment
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 可采取行动的代表性调整

blocks.en:
As discussed above,
we first bridge the observation–action modality gap in predictive VLA via an explicit alignment step.
Recent works [ 10 , 5 ] have explored extracting action semantics from consecutive frames into compact latent representations, motivating structured cross-modal abstractions.
Inspired by these efforts, we propose Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook to bridge this modality gap, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
To ensure effective alignment, we enforce temporal consistency and causal alignment between observation and action representations by adopting a symmetric, predictive design across both branches.
Predictive and action representations are mapped into a shared discrete latent via a unified codebook, grounding predictive latents in the action space.
blocks.zh:
如上所述,
我们首先通过明确的对齐步骤,弥合预测VLA中的观察-行动模式差距。
近期的作品[10,5]探索了将动作语义从连续的框架中提取成紧凑的潜在表述,激发了结构化的跨模式抽象.
在这些努力的启发下,我们提议通过共同守则来调整可采取行动的代表性,以弥合这一模式差距,如图2所示。
为了确保有效的协调,我们通过在两个分支之间采用对称、预测性的设计,在观察和行动表述之间实现时间一致性和因果一致性。
通过一个统一的密码簿,将预测和行动表述映射成一个共享的离散潜伏,将预测潜伏在行动空间中。

blocks.en:
Modality-Specific Encoding. Specifically, given the current observation–action pair ( 𝒪 t , 𝒜 t ) (\mathcal{O}_{t},\mathcal{A}_{t}) and the future pair ( 𝒪 t + n , 𝒜 t + n ) (\mathcal{O}_{t+n},\mathcal{A}_{t+n}) , where n n denotes the action chunk size,
we encode 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} and 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} using modality-specific encoders f 𝒪 ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot) and f 𝒜 ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\mathcal{A}}(\cdot) .
To explicitly align the two modalities, we introduce a shared codebook 𝒞 = { 𝐜 k } k = 1 K ⊂ ℝ d \mathcal{C}=\{\mathbf{c}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K}\subset\mathbb{R}^{d} ,
which defines a unified discrete latent space.
Given a continuous embedding 𝐳 ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} ,
the vector quantization operator Quant ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathrm{Quant}(\cdot) maps it to the nearest codeword in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} : Quant ⁡ ( 𝐳 ) = 𝐜 k ∗ , k ∗ = arg ⁡ min ⁡ ‖ 𝐳 − 𝐜 k ‖ 2 2 . \small\mathrm{Quant}(\mathbf{z})=\mathbf{c}_{k^{\ast}},\;k^{\ast}=\arg\min\|\mathbf{z}-\mathbf{c}_{k}\|_{2}^{2}. (5) Using this shared quantization process, the encoded observation and action
representations are mapped into the same discrete latent space: 𝐙 𝒪 t = Quant ⁡ ( f 𝒪 ​ ( 𝒪 t ) ) , 𝐙 𝒜 t = Quant ⁡ ( f 𝒜 ​ ( 𝒜 t ) ) . \small\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}=\mathrm{Quant}\!\left(f_{\mathcal{O}}(\mathcal{O}_{t})\right),\;\;\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{A}_{t}}=\mathrm{Quant}\!\left(f_{\mathcal{A}}(\mathcal{A}_{t})\right). (6) Unified Decoding. Given the discrete latent representations 𝐙 𝒪 t \mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}} and 𝐙 𝒜 t \mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{A}_{t}} obtained from the shared codebook,
we employ a unified decoder composed of stacked self-attention and cross-attention layers
to jointly model future observations and actions.
We first construct the input token sequence by concatenating the current observation
and action, denoted as 𝐗 t = [ 𝒪 t , 𝒜 t ] \mathbf{X}_{t}=[\mathcal{O}_{t},\mathcal{A}_{t}] .
These tokens are fed into self-attention to capture intra- and cross-modal dependencies: 𝐇 t self = SelfAttn ⁡ ( 𝐗 t ) = Softmax ⁡ ( 𝐐 t ​ 𝐊 t ⊤ d ) ​ 𝐕 t , \small\mathbf{H}_{t}^{\text{self}}=\mathrm{SelfAttn}(\mathbf{X}_{t})=\mathrm{Softmax}\!\left(\frac{\mathbf{Q}_{t}\mathbf{K}_{t}^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}\right)\mathbf{V}_{t}, (7) where 𝐐 t \mathbf{Q}_{t} , 𝐊 t \mathbf{K}_{t} , and 𝐕 t \mathbf{V}_{t} are the query, key, and value projections of 𝐗 t \mathbf{X}_{t} , respectively.
Next, the self-attended representation 𝐇 t self \mathbf{H}_{t}^{\text{self}} is used as the query in a cross-attention block,
which attends to the concatenated discrete latents 𝐙 t = [ 𝐙 𝒪 t , 𝐙 𝒜 t ] \mathbf{Z}_{t}=[\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}},\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{A}_{t}}] serving as keys and values: 𝐇 t + n = CrossAttn ⁡ ( 𝐇 t self , 𝐙 t , 𝐙 t ) . \small\mathbf{H}_{t+n}=\mathrm{CrossAttn}(\mathbf{H}_{t}^{\text{self}},\mathbf{Z}_{t},\mathbf{Z}_{t}). (8) The resulting hidden representation 𝐇 t + n \mathbf{H}_{t+n} encodes predictive, action-aware semantics grounded in the shared discrete latent space.
Two lightweight projection heads, MLP 𝒪 \mathrm{MLP}_{\mathcal{O}} and MLP 𝒜 \mathrm{MLP}_{\mathcal{A}} ,
are then applied to map 𝐇 t + n \mathbf{H}_{t+n} to the future observation and action predictions, respectively: 𝒪 ^ t + n = MLP 𝒪 ​ ( 𝐇 t + n ) , 𝒜 ^ t + n = MLP 𝒜 ​ ( 𝐇 t + n ) . \small\hat{\mathcal{O}}_{t+n}=\mathrm{MLP}_{\mathcal{O}}(\mathbf{H}_{t+n}),\;\hat{\mathcal{A}}_{t+n}=\mathrm{MLP}_{\mathcal{A}}(\mathbf{H}_{t+n}). (9) Training Objective. Specifically, the training objective consists of two components: an observation prediction loss and an action prediction loss. The overall alignment objective is defined as ℒ align = λ 𝒪 ​ ℒ obs ​ ( 𝒪 ^ t + n , 𝒪 t + n ) + λ 𝒜 ​ ℒ act ​ ( 𝒜 ^ t + n , 𝒜 t + n ) , \small\mathcal{L}_{\text{align}}=\lambda_{\mathcal{O}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{obs}}\big(\hat{\mathcal{O}}_{t+n},\mathcal{O}_{t+n}\big)+\lambda_{\mathcal{A}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{act}}\big(\hat{\mathcal{A}}_{t+n},\mathcal{A}_{t+n}\big), (10) where ℒ obs \mathcal{L}_{\text{obs}} and ℒ act \mathcal{L}_{\text{act}} measure errors for observation and action prediction, and λ 𝒪 , λ 𝒜 \lambda_{\mathcal{O}},\lambda_{\mathcal{A}} balance the two terms. This objective encourages the shared discrete latent space to encode temporally consistent, causally aligned semantics. As shown in Fig. 2 , the observation and action latents are initially dispersed and modality-separated, but progressively co-locate and consolidate into a coherent shared structure during Alignment training. This trend suggests that our method effectively reduces cross-modal misalignment and grounds predictive latents in action-relevant semantics. Beyond empirical evidence, we also provide theoretical grounding for this design in Appendix D.1 .

we next integrate predictive information into action generation.
We use predictive latents purely as guidance while retaining a single action-centric objective.
A straightforward choice is to inject predictive signals at every decoding layer. However, our theoretical analysis (Appendix D.2 ) and empirical results (Tab. 7 ) show that dense, layer-wise injection can over-constrain decoding, degrading control precision and destabilizing training. This reflects that predictive cues are not uniformly beneficial across the decoding hierarchy: early layers primarily benefit from coarse semantic guidance, whereas later layers require fine-grained motor control. We therefore introduce predictive information adaptively , rather than coupling it to every decoding step.

接下来我们把预测信息 纳入行动生成。

一个直接的选择是在每个解码层注入预测信号. 然而,我们的理论分析(Appendix D.2 )和经验结果(Tab. 7)表明,密集的,分层的注射可以过度约束解码,降低控制精度和破坏稳定的训练. 这反映出预测提示在解码层级上并不一致:早期的层主要受益于粗细的语义引导,而后期的层则需要精细的导电控制. 因此,我们以适应性的方式引入预测性信息,而不是将其与每一个解码步骤结合起来。

Adaptive Side-Path Injection. As illustrated in Fig. 3 ,
we introduce a lightweight adaptive side-path that operates in parallel
with a large language model (LLM) backbone,
enabling predictive information to guide action generation
without interfering with the core action-centric optimization.
At each time step t t , the LLM receives the following inputs:
the current visual observation 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} ,
a natural language instruction ℐ \mathcal{I} ,
and a set of learnable action query tokens 𝐓 act \mathbf{T}_{\text{act}} with length l a l_{a} , which are responsible for generating an n n -step action chunk.
These inputs are first embedded and concatenated to form the initial sequence: 𝐇 0 = [ f 𝒪 ​ ( 𝒪 t ) , f ℐ ​ ( ℐ ) , 𝐓 act ] , \small\mathbf{H}_{0}=\Big[f_{\mathcal{O}}(\mathcal{O}_{t}),\,f_{\mathcal{I}}(\mathcal{I}),\,\mathbf{T}_{\text{act}}\Big], (11) where f 𝒪 ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot) and f ℐ ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\mathcal{I}}(\cdot) denote the observation and instruction encoders, respectively. The sequence is then fed into L L stacked LLM Layers, yielding hidden states iteratively: 𝐇 l = LLMLayer l ( 𝐇 l − 1 ) , l = 1 , … , L . \small\mathbf{H}_{l}=\mathrm{LLMLayer}_{l}(\mathbf{H}_{l-1}),\hskip 18.49988ptl=1,\ldots,L. (12) In parallel, we obtain the predictive latent 𝐙 𝒪 t \mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}} by encoding 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} and quantizing it with the shared codebook.
This latent encodes predictive observation information
and serves as the sole source of look-ahead guidance for the LLM. Before each injection, the predictive latent is updated as: 𝐙 𝒪 t ( l ) = 𝐙 𝒪 t ( l − 1 ) + FFN ⁡ ( 𝐙 𝒪 t ( l − 1 ) ) , \small\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}^{(l)}=\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}^{(l-1)}+\mathrm{FFN}\!\left(\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}^{(l-1)}\right), (13) with 𝐙 𝒪 t ( 0 ) = 𝐙 𝒪 t \mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}^{(0)}=\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}} .
This transformation adapts the predictive representation to the abstraction level of different LLM layers, instead of keeping it fixed.

Rather than injecting predictive information at every LLM layer,
we perform injection at regular layer intervals to avoid over-constraining
the decoding process.
Concretely, given an injection frequency s s ,
predictive guidance is applied only when l mod s = 0 l\bmod s=0 .
At an injection layer l l , we extract the hidden states corresponding to
the action query tokens from the LLM output,
denoted as 𝐇 l act ∈ ℝ l a × d \mathbf{H}_{l}^{\text{act}}\in\mathbb{R}^{l_{a}\times d} .
The transformed predictive latent 𝐙 𝒪 t ( l ) \mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}^{(l)} is then injected via cross-attention: 𝐇 l cross = CrossAttn ⁡ ( 𝐇 l act , 𝐙 𝒪 t ( l ) , 𝐙 𝒪 t ( l ) ) , \small\mathbf{H}_{l}^{\text{cross}}=\mathrm{CrossAttn}\big(\mathbf{H}_{l}^{\text{act}},\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}^{(l)},\mathbf{Z}_{\mathcal{O}_{t}}^{(l)}\big), (14) where the action token representations serve as queries,

of predictive guidance at layer l l . After the final LLM layer, the action query representations 𝐇 L act \mathbf{H}_{L}^{\text{act}} are mapped to an n n -step action chunk.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision–Language–Action Models. Vision–Language Models (VLMs) [ 1 , 24 , 55 , 15 , 12 , 39 , 54 , 61 , 43 , 48 , 57 , 56 , 72 , 62 , 63 , 68 , 42 , 40 ] have substantially advanced robotic manipulation by tightly coupling visual perception with linguistic reasoning [ 53 , 28 , 66 , 26 , 41 ] . Building on this foundation, RT-2 [ 4 ] pioneered the integration of pre-trained VLMs into Vision–Language–Action modeling, while RT-X [ 46 ] further scaled this paradigm with large-scale data to improve generalization across tasks. A series of subsequent approaches, including OpenVLA [ 21 ] , OpenVLA-OFT [ 20 ] , and the π \pi -series [ 2 , 18 ] models, further adopt and extend this paradigm, demonstrating strong performance across a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: 展望-语言-行动模式。 远景-语言模型(VLM)[1,24,55,15,12,39,54,61,43,48,57,56,72,62,63,68,42,40]通过紧密结合视觉感知与语言推理[53,28,66,26,41],使机器人操控有了实质性的进步. 在这个基础上,RT-2[4]率先将经过预训的VLM集成到Vision-Langage-Action模型中,而RT-X[46]则以大规模数据进一步放大这一范式,以改善跨任务的概括性. 一系列后续方法,包括OpenVLA [21],OpenVLA-OFT [20],以及 \\pi - 系列 [2,18] 模型,进一步采用和扩展这一范式,在广泛的机器人操纵任务中表现出强大的性能.

blocks.en: Predictive VLA Models. Recently, increasing attention has been paid to incorporating future prediction into Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models to enhance robotic manipulation [ 69 , 67 , 30 , 65 , 34 , 17 ] . Some methods [ 14 , 3 ] employ auxiliary image or video generation models to predict future frames and condition action prediction on the generated goals, introducing additional inference latency. Accordingly, subsequent methods aim to unify action prediction with future modeling, ranging from pixel-level forecasting [ 35 , 71 ] to world knowledge prediction, within a single framework. Despite their strengths, these methods often suffer from modality misalignment and joint optimization conflicts that weaken action-centric learning. In contrast, ATI-VLA explicitly aligns predictive latents with actions and injects them under a single action-centric objective.
blocks.zh: A. 自愿解放军 模特儿们 最近,人们越来越重视将未来的预测纳入Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型,以加强机器人操纵[69、67、30、65、34、17]。 一些方法[14,3]使用辅助图像或视频生成模型来预测未来帧和对生成目标的条件动作预测,引入额外的推论延迟. 因此,随后的方法旨在将动作预测与未来的模型统一起来,从像素级预测[35,71]到世界知识预测,在一个单一的框架内进行. 尽管这些方法具有优势,但它们往往受到模式错位和联合优化冲突的影响,削弱了以行动为中心的学习。 相比之下,ATI-VLA明确将预测性潜伏物与行动联系起来,并在一个以行动为中心的单一目标下注入它们。

blocks.en:
Robotic Manipulation in Learned Latent Spaces. Recent research explores compact, structured latent representations for robotic planning and control [ 58 , 37 , 22 , 23 ] .
VQ-BeT [ 22 ] and STAR [ 23 ] learn discrete action or skill representations to support transformer-based policy learning, while other approaches learn transferable latent skills from internet-scale human videos [ 60 , 10 , 5 , 9 , 38 ] .
Both lines of work emphasize learning latent action or skill representations, whereas ATI-VLA targets the observation–action modality gap in predictive VLA.
It also shares the use of discrete codebooks with recent action tokenizers [ 47 , 13 ] , but differs in the supervision and role of its codebook.
Specifically, it learns shared, action-grounded prototypes by jointly predicting future observations and actions rather than reconstructing inputs.
The resulting observation latents guide action decoding under a single action objective rather than serve as output action tokens. More closely related, VITA [ 36 ] also learns a shared visual–action codebook.
ATI-VLA nevertheless differs in:
(1) codebook architecture and learning , using a unified decoder for joint future observation–action prediction rather than separate autoencoders for modality-specific reconstruction;
(2) policy architecture , injecting predictive latents through an adaptive side-path rather than generating shared tokens for dual visual–action decoding;
and (3) optimization , freezing the alignment module and using only the action loss in Stage 2, whereas VITA [ 36 ] jointly optimizes observation and action losses during co-training.
blocks.zh:
学习后期空间的机器人操纵 最近的研究探索了机器人规划和控制的紧凑、结构化的潜在表述[58、37、22、23]。
VQ-BET [22]和STAR [23] 学习独立行动或技能表述,以支持基于变压器的政策学习,而其他方法则从互联网规模的人类视频中学习可转移的潜在技能[60、10、5、9、38]。
这两类工作都强调学习潜在的行动或技能表现,而ATI-VLA则针对预测的VLA中的观察-行动模式差距。
它还与最近的动作指示器共享使用离散代码本[47,13],但其代码本的监督和作用有所不同.
具体而言,它通过共同预测今后的观察和行动,而不是重建投入,来学习共同的、以行动为基础的原型。
由此产生的观测潜伏作用指导着在一个行动目标下进行行动解码,而不是作为产出行动符号。 更紧密的关联,VITA [36] 也学习了一套共享的视觉-动作代码本.
然而,ATI-VLA在下列方面有所不同:
(1) 编码本架构和学习,使用统一的解码器进行联合未来观察-行动预测,而不是为特定模式的重建使用单独的自动编码器;
(2) 政策结构,通过适应性的侧路注入预测潜力,而不是为双重视觉-动作解码产生共同的信号;
和(3)优化,冻结校正模块,仅使用第2阶段的动作损失,而VITA[36]联合优化了联合训练期间的观察和行动损失.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose ATI-VLA , an action-centric predictive VLA framework that overcomes modality misalignment and optimization conflicts via an Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection design. It first aligns observations and actions in a shared discrete latent space, then adaptively injects predictive latents under a single action objective, achieving state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence. This demonstrates how explicit alignment and adaptive injection can fully realize the potential of predictive VLA for robust robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ATI-VLA,这是一个以行动为中心的预测VLA框架,通过可操作的对齐,然后适应性的注射设计,克服模式的错配和优化冲突。 它首先将观测和行动放在一个共享的离散潜伏空间,然后在单一行动目标下适应性地注入预测潜伏,以更快的趋同速度实现最新性能。 这表明明确对齐和适应性注入如何能够充分实现预测的VLA对强力机器人操纵的潜力。

blocks.en: A.1 Model Details
blocks.zh: A.1 示范细节

blocks.en: Structural Details of Actionable Representation Alignment. In the Actionable Representation Alignment stage of ATI - VLA, we implement three core components: • Observation Encoder employs a patch - embedding layer followed by a spatial Transformer to extract visual tokens, which are then quantized into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook. It processes a single input frame and outputs a set of discrete latent codes that capture spatial and semantic information of the scene. • Action Encoder uses a lightweight MLP to project the current action vector into a spatially - aligned embedding grid, which is similarly quantized through the same shared codebook. This ensures that action representations share the same discrete latent structure as visual observations, enabling cross - modal alignment. • Unified Decoder is built with stacked self - attention and cross - attention layers, taking the quantized latent representations of both observation and action as context to jointly predict the future observation and future action. The self - attention captures intra - modal dependencies, while cross - attention fuses the aligned observation and action latents for coherent multi - modal prediction.

Base Framework and Implementation. ATI-VLA adopts OpenVLA-OFT [ 20 ] as its implementation framework, with OpenVLA-7B [ 21 ] serving as the underlying backbone.

基本框架和执行。 ATI-VLA采用OpenVLA-OFT[20]作为其执行框架,OpenVLA-7B[21]作为基础骨干.

blocks.en:
Inference Mechanism. Unlike video-generation-based policies, ATI-VLA does not require explicit future-observation decoding during inference.
Consistent with the use of predictive latent representations in DreamVLA [ 67 ] and Seer [ 45 ] , ATI-VLA directly exploits predictive information in latent space to guide action generation.
Specifically, in stage 1, the alignment module is trained with both future-observation and action supervision to learn future-aware, action-grounded representations. This module is subsequently frozen but retained at inference time: the current observation is mapped into the learned latent space, and the resulting predictive latent is adaptively injected into the action decoder as an explicit guidance signal. Therefore, although ATI-VLA does not perform an explicit future-observation rollout at test time, the predictive information learned in Stage 1 continues to directly guide action generation through the retained adaptive side-path.

具体地说,在第一阶段,调整模块接受了未来观察和行动监督的培训,以学习未来认识的、基于行动的表现。 这个模块随后被冻结,但在推论时被保留:目前的观测被映射到所学到的潜在空间中,由此产生的预测潜被适应性地注入到动作解码器中,作为明确的指导信号. 因此,尽管ATI-VLA没有在试验时进行明确的未来观测推广,但第一阶段所学到的预测信息继续直接指导通过保留的适应性侧路产生行动。

Training proceeds with a batch size of 64, initiated at a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . The action sequence length is set to n = 8 n=8 . Validation is performed on benchmark tasks at intervals of every 5,000 steps, with the model checkpoint delivering the highest validation performance being selected for final reporting. Regarding the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, we utilize a batch size of 32, an initial learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , and an action chunk size of 25.

blocks.en: LIBERO is a language-conditioned manipulation benchmark that evaluates complementary facets of robotic capability through multiple task suites. • LIBERO-Spatial contains 10 tasks with identical objects arranged in varied layouts, emphasizing spatial reasoning. • LIBERO-Object includes 10 tasks with fixed layouts but different object instances, testing object-level generalization. • LIBERO-Goal comprises 10 tasks sharing object categories and layouts while varying goals, assessing goal-conditioned behavior diversity. • LIBERO-Long consists of 10 challenging long-horizon tasks across diverse objects and scenes, stressing temporal reasoning and sequential control. We follow the standard protocol and use 50 expert demonstrations per task from the official release.

blocks.en: RoboTwin 2.0 provides a large-scale benchmark for bimanual manipulation, built on an asset library of 731 objects across 147 categories. It defines 50 dual-arm tasks with expert trajectories generated via an MLLM-driven simulation pipeline. To enhance robustness and sim-to-real transfer, it incorporates structured domain randomization across clutter, lighting, backgrounds, table height, and instructions. For evaluation, four tasks are selected: Click Bell, Open Laptop, Place Container Plate, and Place Bread Skillet , each evaluated over 100 trials.
blocks.zh: RoboTwin 2.0为双人操控提供了大规模基准,基于一个跨147类731个对象的资产库. 它定义了50项双臂任务,通过MLLM驱动的模拟管道产生专家轨道. 为了增强稳健性并实现实实在在的转移,它包含了结构化的域随机化,跨越杂乱,照明,背景,桌高,以及指令. 为评价起见,选择了四项任务:点击贝尔、开放的笔记本电脑、Place Control Plate和Place Bread Skilet,各评价100多次试验。

blocks.en: B.2 Real-World Tasks
blocks.zh: B.2 现实世界的任务

blocks.en: Task Descriptions. We deploy ATI-VLA on Galaxea R1 Lite and AgileX Cobot Magic platforms for real-world evaluation across five long-horizon sequential manipulation tasks that span four core capability categories: Object Packing (evaluating dual-arm coordination and container manipulation), Markers Collection (testing fine-grained precision manipulation), Plate Handover (assessing dynamic object transfer and bimanual interaction), and T-shirt Folding (examining deformable object handling in both standard and OOD configurations). These tasks collectively challenge fundamental robotic capabilities including precision manipulation, bimanual coordination, bimanual handover, and dynamic adaptation under uncertainty. Tasks requiring dual-arm coordination (Object Packing, Plate Handover, and both T-shirt Folding variants) evaluate spatial-temporal synchronization and inter-arm transfer, while Markers Collection isolates fine motor control in a single-arm precision scenario. Each task is evaluated through progressive stage success rates to assess intermediate performance, with 50 human-teleoperated demonstrations collected per task to ensure sufficient training data diversity. Details are provided below.
blocks.zh: 任务描述. 在Galaxea R1 Lite和AgileX Cobot Magic平台上部署ATI-VLA,用于实时世界评价,涉及涵盖四个核心能力类别的五个长视连续操纵任务: 对象包装(评价双臂协调和容器操纵),标记器集(测试精细精细操纵),板块移交(评估动态对象转移和双人交互),T恤折叠(在标准配置和OOD配置中考察可变形对象处理). 这些任务共同挑战基本的机器人能力,包括精确操纵、双人协调、双人交接和不确定情况下的动态适应。 需要双臂协调的任务(Object Packing,Plate Handover,以及两件T-shirt Folding变体)评价空间-时空同步和双臂间转移,而Markers Collection则在单臂精准情况下隔离精细的马达控制. 每项任务通过渐进阶段的成功率进行评估,以评估中间性能,每个任务收集50个人力操作演示,以确保培训数据的充分多样性。 详情如下。

blocks.en: • Object Packing Instruction:“Pack the object on the table into the bag.” This dual-arm sequential manipulation task evaluates coordinated bimanual operation for container handling and object packing, requiring precise temporal coordination and spatial reasoning. The progressive stages include: 1) “Open” – securely open the bag and maintain its accessible configuration, and 2) “+Pack” – accurately placing tabletop item into the bag while maintaining bag stability. • Markers Collection Instruction:“Put the markers into the cup.” This task assesses the limits of fine-grained precision manipulation through slender object handling and constrained placement, demanding high precision and delicate handling. The two-stage operation involves: 1) “C1” – picking up the first marker and inserting it into the cup with precise orientation control, and 2) “+C2” – repeating the process for the second marker while avoiding collisions with the first. • Plate Handover Instruction:“Place the plate on the right into the basket on the left.” This dual-arm handover task evaluates dynamic object transfer and inter-arm coordination, focusing on seamless spatial-temporal synchronization during object exchange. The three-stage sequence comprises: 1) “Pick” – grasping the target plate securely with the right arm, 2) “+Pass” – smoothly transferring the plate to the left arm through a coordinated handover maneuver that maintains object stability throughout the exchange, and 3) “+Place” – accurately positioning the plate onto the left-side target plate. • T-shirt Folding (In-distribution) Instruction:“Fold the T-shirt.” This deformable object manipulation task examines fabric handling and structured folding execution, demanding comprehensive multi-step planning and sustained task coherence across complex operation chains. Following the established three-stage protocol: 1) “Step 1” – firmly grasping the T-shirt edge and executing the first controlled folding motion across the garment surface, 2) “Step 2” – repeating the folding motion to reinforce the fold, and 3) “Step 3” – grasping the right side of the T-shirt and folding it over to the left side. • T-shirt Folding (Out-of-Distribution Variant) Instruction:“Fold the T-shirt.” This out-of-distribution variant evaluates generalization capabilities when confronted with systematic variations in garment attributes, while preserving the core folding skill. The task follows the identical three-stage folding procedure, but introduces key variations in the T-shirt properties: 1) the garment exhibits differing visual characteristics including color not seen during training, and 2) the T-shirt dimensions and sizes are altered.
blocks.zh: • 支助 对象包装指令:“将桌上的物体放入袋中。” 这种双臂相继操纵的任务评价了集装箱装卸和物品包装的协调双人操作,需要精确的时间协调和空间推理. 进步阶段包括: 1) “打开”-安全打开袋并保持其无障碍配置;2)“+包”-在袋内准确放置桌面物品,同时保持袋的稳定。 • 标记收集指示:“将标记放入杯中。” 这项任务通过细细的物体处理和限制放置来评估精细精密操纵的限度,要求高精度和微妙的处理. 两级行动包括: 1) “C1” – 拿起第一个标记并将其插入杯中,精确的定向控制;2) “+C2” – 重复第二个标记的过程,同时避免与第一个标记相撞。 • 板块移交指示:“将右边的板块放进左边的篮子。” 这种双臂交接任务评价了动态物体转移和臂间协调,重点是在物体交换过程中无缝空间-时空同步. 三阶段序列包括: 1) " Pick " –用右臂安全地抓住目标板,2) " +Pass " –通过协调的交接策略将板块顺利地转移至左臂,在整个交换过程中保持物体稳定性,3) " +Place " –将板块准确定位在左侧目标板上. • T恤折叠(分发)指示:“折叠T恤”。 这一可变形物体操纵任务考察了织物处理和结构式折叠执行,要求全面多步骤规划和整个复杂操作链的持续任务一致性. 根据既定的三阶段议定书: 1) “步骤1”——牢牢抓住T恤的边缘,对服装表面实施第一个可控折叠运动;2) “步骤2”——重复折叠运动,加强折叠;3) “步骤3”——抓住T恤的右侧,将其折叠到左侧。 • T恤折叠(分发外的变体)说明书:“T恤折叠”。 这种分配外的变体在面对服装属性的系统变化时,在保留核心折叠技能的同时,评价通缩能力. 这项任务遵循相同的三阶段折叠程序,但引入了T恤特性的关键变化: 1) 服装显示不同的视觉特征,包括在训练期间没有看到的颜色;2) 改变T恤尺寸和尺寸。

blocks.en: Data Collection and Augmentation. Real-world training data for all tasks is collected via human teleoperation, with 50 expert demonstrations per task. Augmentation strategies include randomized object positions, container orientations, and initial arm configurations to simulate realistic execution variability.

blocks.en: 2) Predictive VLA models. These methods incorporate look-ahead signals (e.g., future observations, latent dynamics, or world states) to guide action generation: • Seer [ 45 ] learns predictive inverse dynamics by forecasting future visual states and predicting actions conditioned on the forecast, enabling scalable pretraining and sim-to-real adaptation. • DreamVLA [ 67 ] forecasts compact world knowledge (dynamic/spatial/semantic cues) and uses it for inverse dynamics in a perception–prediction–action loop, with structured attention to disentangle signals and a diffusion-based Transformer for action modeling. • CoT-VLA [ 69 ] adds explicit visual chain-of-thought by autoregressively predicting future frames as intermediate visual goals, then generating short action chunks to reach these goals. • ℱ 1 \mathcal{F}_{1} [ 35 ] integrates visual foresight into decision making via a modular Mixture-of-Transformers, predicting goal-conditioned future visuals as planning targets and generating actions through foresight-guided inverse dynamics. • H-GAR [ 73 ] introduces a hierarchical interaction framework that refines observation–action trajectories in a goal-driven manner for robotic manipulation. • UniVLA [ 5 ] learns cross-embodiment VLA policies by deriving task-centric latent action representations from videos, enabling scalable pretraining on heterogeneous (including human) videos and efficient deployment via latent action decoding. We further include an ablated variant, ATI-VLA w/o alignment , which jointly models future observations and actions in a single framework but removes the explicit Actionable Representation Alignment stage, isolating the effect of alignment from other components of the framework.

blocks.en:
Trade-off Analysis. As shown in Table 10 , ATI-VLA consistently improves task performance over OpenVLA-OFT with only 0.7% additional FLOPs, while reducing total training time by 46.4% (30.2 to 16.2 hours).
These results demonstrate that ATI-VLA improves policy performance while maintaining comparable computational complexity and substantially reducing training cost.
blocks.zh:
权衡分析. 如表10所示,ATI-VLA持续改进OpenVLA-OFT的任务性能,仅增加0.7%的FLOP,同时将总培训时间减少46.4%(30.2小时至16.2小时)。
这些结果表明,ATI-VLA改进了政策业绩,同时保持了可比的计算复杂性并大大减少了培训费用。

blocks.en:
Controlled Same-Backbone Ablation. To isolate where the performance gains come from, we conduct a controlled same-backbone ablation. All variants use the same backbone, training data, and evaluation protocol, and differ only in their predictive design.
As shown in Table 11 , direct future prediction yields only limited improvement, while injection without alignment even degrades performance, suggesting that unaligned predictive features may interfere with action decoding. Incorporating alignment improves performance, and the full ATI-VLA achieves the best results across both simulation and real-world settings. These results indicate that the gains primarily stem from the combination of actionable alignment and adaptive injection, rather than from extra supervision, model capacity, or training budget.
blocks.zh:
控制了同Backbone Ablusion. (英语). 为了分离性能收益的来源,我们进行受控的同腰骨萎缩. 所有变体使用相同的主干,培训数据,以及评价协议,仅在预测设计上有所不同.
如表11所示,直接的未来预测只能产生有限的改进,而没有对齐的注射甚至会降低性能,这表明不对齐的预测特征可能会干扰动作解码. 纳入对齐可以提高性能,全面的ATI-VLA在模拟和现实世界的设置中都取得了最佳效果. 这些结果表明,收益主要来自可采取行动的调整和适应性注入,而不是额外的监督、示范能力或培训预算。

blocks.en: Table 12 : Controlled Comparison over Predicted Modalities. All variants use the same backbone, training data, and evaluation protocol, differing only in the predicted modality and predictive design. Results report average success rates.
blocks.zh: 表12:对预测方式的控制比较。 所有变体使用相同的主干、培训数据和评价协议,仅在预测模式和预测设计上有所不同。 结果报告了平均成功率。

blocks.en: Table 13 : Generalization of Injection Interval Across Backbones. We evaluate LLM backbones with different attention patterns and normalization schemes. The preferred injection interval remains around one-third to one-fourth of the model depth.
blocks.zh: 表13:注射力跨后骨的通用化。 我们以不同的关注模式和正常化计划来评价LLM的支柱。 首选的注射间隔仍保持在模型深度的三分之一至四分之一左右.

blocks.en: Controlled Comparison over Predicted Modalities. To account for different predicted modalities for a fair comparison, we reproduce two representative variants under the same framework: an image-prediction variant following the spirit of CoT-VLA [ 69 ] , and a world-knowledge-prediction variant following the spirit of DreamVLA [ 67 ] . As shown in Table 12 , both variants underperform ATI-VLA, especially on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world tasks. This suggests that the gains do not simply come from predicting a particular modality, but from making predictive representations actionable through alignment and injecting them into action decoding in an adaptive, action-centric manner.
blocks.zh: 对预测模式的控制比较。 为了说明公平比较的不同预测方式,我们在同一框架下转载了两个有代表性的变体:一个是遵循CoT-VLA[69]精神的图像预测变体,另一个是遵循DreamVLA[67]精神的世界知识预测变体。 如表12所示,两种变体都表现不佳ATI-VLA,特别是在RoboTwin 2.0和现实世界的任务上. 这表明,收益不仅来自对某种特定模式的预测,还来自通过调整预测性表述可以采取行动,并以适应性和以行动为中心的方式将其注入行动解码。

blocks.en: Generalization of Injection Interval Across Backbones. We conduct ablation experiments on the injection interval using LLM backbones with different attention patterns and normalization schemes. The results in Tab. 13 show that the best interval remains around one-third to one-fourth of the model depth, indicating that this trend is not specific to specific backbone. Overall, dense injection tends to over-constrain action decoding, while overly sparse injection provides insufficient predictive guidance. Thus, interval-based injection reflects a general trade-off, although the exact optimum may slightly vary across backbone families. Importantly, this does not introduce a substantial tuning burden, since the empirical search space is largely narrowed to a small range around one-third to one-fourth of the backbone depth.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-03-21). Expension of Injection Interval Cross Backbones. 我们使用不同关注模式和正常化计划的LLM主干线,对注射间隔进行消毒试验。 Tab.13的结果显示,最佳间隔仍保持在模型深度的三分之一至四分之一左右,表明这一趋势并非针对特定的骨干. 总体而言,密集注射往往会过度约束动作解码,而过少的注射则不能提供足够的预测指导. 因此,基于间隔的注射反映了一般的权衡,尽管确切的最佳选择可能因骨干家庭而略有不同。 重要的是,这并没有带来实质性的调整负担,因为经验搜索空间大致缩小到三分之一至四分之一主干线深度左右的小范围。

blocks.en:
Ablation on Stage-1 Alignment Design. We further analyze the design of Stage-1 alignment in Table 14 . Although Stage 2 injects observation-side latents, action information in Stage 1 is still essential because the goal is to learn an action-grounded shared latent space. Compared with observation-only alignment, using both observations and actions improves performance. This indicates that action-side supervision helps observation latents encode control-relevant factors rather than merely visual appearance.
We also compare predictive alignment with a simpler reconstruction-based objective. Reconstruction-based alignment achieves lower performance across all settings. This suggests that reconstruction alone is insufficient to learn future-oriented actionable semantics. In contrast, our predictive alignment objective encourages the shared latent space to capture action-induced state transitions, leading to stronger and more transferable action guidance.
blocks.zh:
在阶段一对齐设计上出现偏差. 我们进一步分析了表14中的第一阶段对齐的设计。 虽然第二阶段注入了观测侧潜,但第一阶段的行动信息仍然至关重要,因为其目标是学习一个基于行动的共享潜在空间。 与只观察的对齐相比,既使用观察,又使用动作可以提高性能. 这表明,动作侧监督有助于观察潜伏的编码控制相关因素,而不仅仅是视觉外观。
我们还将预测调整与更简单的重建目标进行比较。 基于重建的调整在所有情况下都取得了较低的业绩。 这表明仅靠重建不足以学习面向未来的可操作语义. 与此相反,我们的预测调整目标鼓励共享潜在空间,以抓住行动引起的国家过渡,从而产生更有力和更可转移的行动指导。

blocks.zh: 表14:第1阶段对齐设计方面的考虑。 我们审查行动信息和预测性学习对于学习基于行动的潜在表现是否必要。

ATI-VLA achieves a 97.9 % 97.9\% average success rate with only 0.1 % 0.1\% standard deviation, indicating stable performance across seeds. The small variance on all suites further suggests that the reported gains are not due to random fluctuations.

blocks.en: C.2 Deeper Analysis of Modality Gaps and Optimization Conflicts.
blocks.zh: C.2 更深入地分析模式差距和优化冲突。

blocks.en: C.2.1 Modality Gaps.
blocks.zh: C.2.1 模式差距。

blocks.en: (1) What kind of failures occur. As shown in Table 15 , the non-aligned variant does not fail diffusely; instead, its failures concentrate on concrete and interpretable cases, including wrong target selection, inaccurate approach poses, mis-oriented placements, and failures to switch actions after subgoal transitions. We categorize these instance-level errors into semantic grounding, pose/control grounding, and transition-phase failures. These failure modes directly reflect the need for strong modality alignment, since the policy must translate predictive semantics into the correct next action chunk. This is particularly critical in Plate Handover and T-shirt Folding, where successful execution requires repeated semantic-to-action remapping across multiple subgoals.
blocks.zh: (1)发生何种故障. 如表15所示,不对齐的变式不会分散失败;相反,其失败集中于具体和可解释的案例,包括选择目标错误、方法不准确、位置定位错误,以及在次级目标过渡后未能改变行动。 我们把这些实例级错误分为语义定位、姿势/控制定位和过渡阶段故障。 这些失败模式直接反映了强烈模式对齐的必要性,因为政策必须将预测语义转化为正确的下一个动作块. 这在Plate Handover和T-shirt Folding中尤其重要,因为要成功执行,就必须在多个次级目标之间反复进行语义对行动的重新规划。

blocks.en: Table 15 : Failure-Mode Diagnosis in Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks. We categorize failures on Plate Handover and T-shirt Folding, with 100 trials per task and 200 trials in total for each method. The non-aligned variant fails more often in semantic grounding, pose/control grounding, and transition-phase stages.
blocks.zh: 表15:长效实时世界任务中的失败模式诊断。 我们按板块移交和T恤折叠法对失败进行分类,每项任务共进行100次审判,每项方法共进行200次审判。 不对齐的变体在语义定位、姿势/控制定位和过渡阶段往往失败。

blocks.en: Table 16 : First Dominant Failure Stage in Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks. We report the stage where the first dominant failure occurs on Plate Handover and T-shirt Folding, with 100 trials per task. The non-aligned variant fails more often in later or transition-heavy stages.
blocks.zh: 表16:长视现实世界任务的第一个主要失败阶段。 我们报告在板块移交和T恤折叠上发生第一次主要故障的阶段,每个任务进行100次试验。 不对齐的变体在后期或过渡重的阶段更经常发生故障.

blocks.en: (2) When the first dominant failure occurs. As shown in Table 16 , the first dominant failures of the non-aligned variant are concentrated in later or transition-heavy stages, such as Pass / Place in Plate Handover and the later folding stages in T-shirt Folding. These stages require the policy to re-ground updated predictive semantics into a new control regime after completing previous subgoals. In contrast, ATI-VLA reduces failures across all stages and achieves higher final success rates, suggesting that explicit alignment improves the reliability of semantic-to-action remapping in long-horizon execution.
blocks.zh: (2) 当发生第一次主要故障时。 如表16所示,不结盟变体的首个主要故障集中在后期或过渡重阶段,如Pass / Place in Plate Handover,以及T恤折叠的后期. 这些阶段要求政策在完成先前的次级目标后,将更新的预测语义重新定位为新的控制制度。 相比之下,ATI-VLA减少所有阶段的故障,并实现更高的最终成功率,这表明明确对齐可以提高长距离执行中语义对动作回映的可靠性.

blocks.en: (3) Whether alignment is lower immediately before failure. As shown in Table 17 , using cross-modal similarity as the alignment metric, the non-aligned variant exhibits a clear drop from safe steps to pre-failure steps, with a gap of 0.22. In contrast, ATI-VLA maintains much higher similarity on both safe and pre-failure steps, and reduces the gap to 0.10. This indicates that failures are closely associated with weakened observation–action alignment, especially in high-risk stages immediately before execution errors.
blocks.zh: (3)在失败前是否降低对齐. 如表17所示,采用交叉式相似度作为对齐度量,不对齐的变体显示出从安全步骤到故障前步骤的明显下降,差距为0.22。 相比之下,ATI-VLA在安全步骤和失败前步骤上都保持了更高程度的相似性,并将差距缩小到0.10. 这表明失败与弱化的观察-行动协调密切相关,特别是在执行错误发生前夕的高风险阶段。

blocks.en: Table 17 : Cross-Modal Similarity Before Failure. We compare cross-modal similarity on safe steps and pre-failure steps. The non-aligned variant exhibits a larger alignment drop before failure, while ATI-VLA maintains higher alignment in these high-risk regions.
blocks.zh: 表17: 失败前的跨周期相似性。 我们比较了安全步骤和失败前步骤的跨模式相似性。 不对齐的变体在失败前显示比较大的对齐下降,而ATI-VLA在这些高风险区域则保持较高的对齐.

blocks.en: Overall, these analyses show that modality gaps lead to identifiable failures at key stages, including wrong target selection, incorrect approach or placement poses, and subgoal-switching errors. Such failures are especially frequent in multi-stage transition states, where predictive semantics must be converted into a new action regime. ATI-VLA effectively mitigates these failures by maintaining stronger action-grounded predictive representations.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些分析显示,模式差距导致在关键阶段出现可识别的失败,包括选择目标错误、方法或位置错误以及次级目标转换错误。 在多阶段过渡国家中,这种失败尤其频繁,预测语义必须转化为新的行动制度。 ATI-VLA通过保持更强大的基于行动的预测表述,有效地缓解了这些失败.

blocks.en: C.2.2 Optimization Conflicts.
blocks.zh: C.2.2 优化冲突。

blocks.en: We further examine whether joint prediction-action training introduces optimization conflicts. Specifically, we compute the gradient cosine similarity between the prediction loss and the action loss on shared parameters. As shown in Table 18 , both DreamVLA and our direct-future-prediction variant exhibit negative average cosine similarity and a high ratio of negative gradient pairs, indicating that the two objectives often provide conflicting update directions. Applying PCGrad partially reduces this conflict, improving the average cosine similarity from -0.29 to -0.09 and increasing performance on both RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world tasks. This confirms that gradient interference is a real optimization issue. In contrast, ATI-VLA avoids such conflict by design: after Stage-1 alignment, Stage-2 injection is optimized solely with the action loss, leading to the best performance.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查联合预测-行动培训是否引入优化冲突。 具体来说,我们计算了预测损失和共享参数上的动作损失之间的梯度余弦相似性. 如表18所示,DreamVLA和我们的直接未来预测变体都表现出负平均余弦相似性,负梯度对的比例很高,表明这两个目标往往提供相互矛盾的更新方向. 应用PCGrad可以部分减少这场冲突,提高平均余弦相似度从-0.29提高到-0.09,并提高RoboTwin 2.0和现实世界任务上的性能. 这证实了梯度干扰是一个真正的优化问题. 相比之下,ATI-VLA通过设计避免了这种冲突:在Stage-1对齐后,Stage-2的注射完全随动作损失而优化,导致最佳性能.

blocks.en: C.2.3 Why Is the Modality Gap Severe in Predictive VLA Settings.
blocks.zh: C.2.3 预测的VLA设置为何存在严重模式差距。

blocks.en: Predictive VLA makes the observation–action modality gap more severe because the predicted representation is often learned under an observation-oriented objective but later used for action generation. Specifically, future-observation prediction encourages visually accurate reconstruction of the next scene. However, many visual details, such as background texture, illumination, or pixel-level appearance, are not directly relevant to control. As a result, the predictive latent may encode rich visual information while failing to emphasize action-relevant factors such as target identity, contact state, object pose, or subgoal transition. When such observation-oriented latents are used to guide the action decoder, the policy must implicitly translate them into executable action chunks, which enlarges the modality gap.
blocks.zh: 预测性VLA使观察-行动模式的差距更为严重,因为预测的代表性往往在一个面向观察的目标下得到了解,但后来用于产生行动。 具体来说,未来观察预测鼓励视觉上准确重建下一个场景. 然而,许多视觉细节,如背景纹理,照明,或像素级外观,与控制并不直接相关. 因此,预测潜伏可能编码丰富的视觉信息,同时没有强调与行动有关的因素,如目标身份、接触状态、物体姿势或次级目标过渡。 当这种面向观察的潜在物被用来指导行动解码器时,政策必须隐含地将其转化为可执行的行动块,从而扩大模式差距。

blocks.en: This issue is further amplified by joint prediction-action optimization. In conventional predictive VLA training, the shared representation is optimized by both the prediction loss and the action loss. These two objectives can prefer different features: the prediction loss favors visually faithful future states, whereas the action loss favors compact and control-relevant abstractions. As analyzed in our gradient-conflict study, their gradients can point in conflicting directions, pulling the shared representation away from a purely action-centric solution. Therefore, the modality gap in predictive VLA is not only caused by the inherent difference between observations and actions, but also by the mismatch between the prediction objective and the downstream control objective.
blocks.zh: 联合预测-行动优化使这一问题进一步加重。 在常规预测VLA训练中,通过预测损失和动作损失来优化共享代表. 这两项目标可能倾向于不同的特征:预测损失有利于视觉上忠实的未来状态,而行动损失则有利于紧凑和控制相关的抽象。 正如我们在梯度冲突研究中分析的那样,它们的梯度可以指向相互冲突的方向,使共同表述脱离纯粹以行动为中心的解决办法。 因此,预测VLA中的方式差距不仅是由观测与行动之间的固有差异造成的,也是预测目标与下游控制目标不匹配造成的.

blocks.en: ATI-VLA addresses this issue through the align-then-inject design. Stage 1 uses both observation and action information to learn an action-grounded shared latent space, so that predictive latents encode future-oriented but control-relevant semantics. Stage 2 then injects these aligned latents into action decoding under a single action objective, avoiding further prediction-action optimization conflict. This makes predictive information more directly usable for control rather than leaving the policy to bridge the modality gap implicitly.
blocks.zh: ATI-VLA通过对齐-当时的输入设计来解决这一问题. 第1阶段利用观察和行动信息来学习一个以行动为基础的共享潜伏空间,从而预测潜伏物编码了面向未来但与控制相关的语义。 然后,第二阶段在单一行动目标下将这些配合的潜质注入行动解码,以避免进一步预测-行动优化冲突。 这使得预测信息更直接可用于控制,而不是让政策隐含地弥补模式差距。

blocks.en: C.3 Additional Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: C.3 其他定性结果

blocks.en: Figure 7 presents extended qualitative results of future observation prediction generated from aligned action representations on both the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks. Across diverse scene layouts, object configurations, and task types, the predicted future frames consistently maintain structural fidelity and temporal coherence with the ground truth. Notably, the predictions preserve fine-grained object details and spatial relationships even in cluttered environments and under varying camera viewpoints. This indicates that the aligned latent space successfully encodes actionable scene dynamics that are both predictive and semantically grounded, effectively bridging the observation-action modality gap. The robustness of these predictions across different task suites further confirms that the alignment strategy yields generalizable representations that transfer well beyond the training distribution.
blocks.zh: 图7介绍了根据LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0基准的一致行动说明而得出的未来观测预测的长期质量结果。 在不同的场景布局,对象配置,以及任务类型中,预测的未来帧始终保持结构的忠实性以及与地面真理的时间一致性. 值得注意的是,这些预测保留了精细的物体细节和空间关系,即使在杂乱无章的环境中和在不同相机角度下也是如此。 这表明,对齐的潜在空间成功地编码了既具有预测性又具有集成基础的可操作场景动态,有效地弥补了观测-行动模式的差距。 这些预测在不同任务组别之间的强健性进一步证实,调整战略产生的普遍表述远远超出了培训分配的范围。

blocks.en: Figure 8 illustrates additional real-world execution sequences of all tasks. In the Object Packing sequence, the model demonstrates reliable dual-arm coordination—first opening the bag with stable bimanual manipulation, then precisely placing the object inside while maintaining bag posture. The Markers Collection sequence highlights fine-grained precision manipulation as the robot picks up slender markers and inserts them into a cup with controlled orientation. The Plate Handover sequence shows smooth inter-arm transfer: securely grasping the plate with the right arm, performing a stable handover to the left arm, and accurately placing it onto the target. The T-shirt Folding sequences (both standard and OOD variants) demonstrate robust deformable object manipulation, maintaining coherent folding motions across varying fabric properties and initial configurations. These sequences collectively highlight the framework’s capacity for temporally extended planning, robust bimanual synchronization, and adaptive control under real-world uncertainties.
blocks.zh: 图8说明了所有任务的更多现实世界执行顺序。 在对象包装序列中,该模型显示了可靠的双臂协调——首先用稳定的双手操纵打开包,然后在保持包姿势的同时精确地将物体放置在包内. 标记器收藏序列强调精细的精细操纵,因为机器人会拾起细小的标记,并把它们插入一个带有可控方向的杯子中. 板块交接序列显示平稳的臂间转移:用右臂安全地抓住板块,进行向左臂的稳定交接,并准确地将其放置在目标上. T恤折叠序列(标准变体和OOD变体)显示出强烈的可变形物体操纵,在不同的织物属性和初始配置上保持连贯的折叠运动. 这些序列共同凸显了框架在时间上扩展规划、强力双人同步和在现实世界不确定性下进行适应性控制的能力。

blocks.en: Together, these extended visualizations reinforce that ATI-VLA’s Align-Then-Inject design not only produces semantically consistent future predictions but also translates these predictions into stable, precise, and generalizable real-world manipulation behavior. The alignment stage ensures that predictive representations are grounded in the action space, while the adaptive injection mechanism integrates this guidance in a manner that preserves the autonomy and precision of action decoding.
blocks.zh: 这些扩展的可视化强化了ATI-VLA的Align-Enter-Inject设计不仅产生精致一致的未来预测,还将这些预测转化为稳定,准确和笼统的现实世界操纵行为. 调整阶段确保预测性表达基于动作空间,而适应性注射机制以保持动作解码的自主性和精确性的方式整合了这一指导.

It supports the existence of an intermediate injection regime: denser layer-wise injection accumulates predictive perturbations more strongly through depth, while overly sparse injection weakens predictive guidance. This theoretical trend is consistent with our empirical findings in Table 13 , where the preferred interval remains around L / 3 L/3 to L / 4 L/4 across different LLM backbones.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Although ATI-VLA shows strong performance on simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks, the current training and evaluation are still based on a relatively limited set of manipulation datasets and task scenarios. In particular, the real-world experiments mainly rely on task-specific teleoperated demonstrations, which validate the effectiveness of our align-then-inject design but do not fully cover the diversity of objects, scenes, embodiments, and interaction patterns in open-world manipulation.
A natural direction for future work is to scale ATI-VLA to larger and more heterogeneous robot datasets. Such data could help the alignment module learn a more comprehensive action-grounded latent space and improve the transferability of predictive latents across tasks and platforms. Future work may also incorporate human videos, cross-embodiment trajectories, and self-supervised interaction data to provide richer priors about object affordances and action-induced state transitions, further extending ATI-VLA toward open-ended long-horizon manipulation.
blocks.zh:
虽然ATI-VLA在模拟基准和现实世界的机器人任务上表现出强劲的性能,但目前的培训和评价仍然基于相对有限的一套操纵数据集和任务设想. 特别是,现实世界的实验主要依靠任务特定的远程操作演示,这些演示验证了我们当时的对齐设计的有效性,但并不完全涵盖在开放世界操纵中物体,场景,浮雕,互动模式的多样性.
今后工作的一个自然方向是将ATI-VLA扩大到更大和更多样化的机器人数据集。 这些数据可以帮助调整模块学习更全面的基于行动的潜在空间,提高预测潜力跨任务和平台的可转让性。 今后的工作还可以包括人类视频、跨表现轨迹和自我监督的交互数据,以提供关于物体承受力和行动引起的状态过渡的更丰富的前科,进一步将ATI-VLA扩展到无限制长视距操纵。

blocks.en: Appendix F Broader Impact and Potential Risks
blocks.zh: 附录F 更广泛的影响和潜在风险

blocks.en: ATI-VLA aims to improve the reliability and efficiency of VLA models for long-horizon robotic manipulation. By grounding predictive representations in action generation, it may benefit applications such as assistive robotics, warehouse automation, and flexible manufacturing, while also offering a general direction for action-centric predictive learning in embodied AI.
blocks.zh: ATI-VLA旨在提高VLA模型用于长视距机器人操纵的可靠性和效率. 通过在动作生成中定位预测性表述,它可能有利于辅助机器人、仓库自动化和灵活制造等应用,同时也为体现的AI中以动作为中心的预测性学习提供了总的方向。

blocks.en: Potential risks may arise when stronger robotic policies are deployed in unconstrained or safety-critical environments, where prediction errors, distribution shifts, or incorrect instruction grounding could lead to unintended behaviors. Practical deployment should therefore include safety constraints, human oversight, permission control, and thorough real-world validation. Future work should further study uncertainty-aware execution and failure detection for safer open-world operation.
blocks.zh: 如果在不受约束或安全关键的环境中采用较强的机器人政策,预测错误、分配转移或错误的指令定点可能导致意外行为,就可能产生潜在风险。 因此,实际部署应包括安全限制、人员监督、许可管制和彻底的现实世界验证。 今后的工作应进一步研究认识到不确定性的处决和发现故障,以便开展更安全的开放世界行动。
